description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android project. It specifies a contract for classes that handle log output, including a method 'println' to output log messages with various details.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging node that can output log data and potentially form chains of log processing.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the LogNode to print a log message, including priority, tag, message, and an optional Throwable for exceptions.
